cases.question: ¿Qué cantidades de tipo Consumo y Producido hubo en transformaciones no anuladas durante octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ti.item_type, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad FROM transformation t JOIN transformation_item ti ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND t.date < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY ti.item_type ORDER BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT ti.item_type AS tipo, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad_total FROM public.transformation_item AS ti JOIN public.transformation AS t ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.date < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50
